title: Claude Duet review: user-friendly, sends a helpful morning brief, and spots scheduling conflicts, but can feel like a neurotic personal assistant that nags (Allison Johnson/The Verge)
summary: Allison Johnson / The Verge: Claude Duet review: user-friendly, sends a helpful morning brief, and spots scheduling conflicts, but can feel like a neurotic personal assistant that nags — Normally, the products I test don't offer to help me write up my experience with them. Duet is different.
